completed_batches.behavioral_diff: Added ITenantContextAccessor, DefaultTenantContextAccessor (AsyncLocal-backed), ITenantConfigReader, and ITenantAwareOptions<T> interfaces and stubs in DbConfig.Core; ConfigEntry gained TenantId field defaulting to empty string. NOTE: these types were removed or superseded in B62.

Schema migrations added TenantId nvarchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' column to DbConfig_Entries and DbConfig_AuditEntries on both SQL Server and PostgreSQL; unique constraint updated to (AppName, Environment, TenantId, Key); all four scope columns carry case-sensitive collation. This schema shape is final.

EfCoreConfigStore and InMemoryConfigStore implement tenant-aware GetAllAsync, GetAsync, GetLatestModifiedUtcAsync, DeleteAsync overloads plus GetAllForAllTenantsAsync. Store fallback is NOT implemented at the store layer — that concern moved to TryGet in B62.

DbConfigConfigurationProvider now loads all tenants via GetAllForAllTenantsAsync and builds _tenantData dictionary; the base ConfigurationProvider.Data dictionary exposes only TenantId='' entries. Initial implementation also exposed ITenantConfigReader — replaced in B62 by direct TryGet tenant awareness.

TenantAwareOptions<T> singleton registered via AddTenantAwareOptions<T>; ConcurrentDictionary<string,T> cache per tenant; GetForCurrentTenant() reads ITenantContextAccessor.Current. NOTE: entire abstraction removed in B62; standard IOptionsSnapshot<T> replaces it.

All HTTP endpoints accept ?tenantId= query string (defaults to '' global default); list endpoint also accepts ?allTenants=true; PUT body accepts tenantId; ConfigEntryDto JSON includes tenantId field; backward-compatible — omitting tenantId behaves identically to pre-v0.9.0.

UI scopeStore gained tenantId field; ScopeSelector added Tenant input; EntriesTable and EntriesTreeView show Tenant column with Default/tenant-name badges; CreateEntryDialog pre-fills TenantId from current scope; EditValueDialog shows tenant in title; demo data includes Acme and Globex tenant overrides.
Demo Program.cs initial version used ITenantContextAccessor middleware pattern; later updated in B62 to use DemoTenantResolver implementing ITenantResolver and reading X-Tenant-Id header.
Initial docs batch for the original three-layer design. All docs rewritten in B63 to match the B62 ITenantResolver design.

Refactored multi-tenant design: removed ITenantContextAccessor, DefaultTenantContextAccessor, ITenantConfigReader, ITenantAwareOptions<T>, TenantAwareOptions<T>, TenantAwareOptionsBuilder, AddTenantAwareOptions extension. Added ITenantResolver (consumer-implemented, single method string? Resolve()), NullTenantResolver (internal, returns null), DbConfigBuilder.AddTenantResolver<T>(). DbConfigConfigurationProvider.TryGet now resolves ITenantResolver from host DI (lazily cached) on every read; returns tenant-specific entry if resolver returns a non-empty id, falls back to global. Standard IOptionsSnapshot<T> automatically tenant-aware because it rebinds from IConfiguration per request scope. Demo updated to DemoTenantResolver class reading X-Tenant-Id header. Test count net -17 from removed abstraction tests, +3 from new resolver tests = 287.

Composed IncludeScopes × Tenants resolution in DbConfigConfigurationProvider. Previously these were mutually exclusive (one or the other). The polling provider's load query now uses AppName IN (own + IncludeScopes) AND fetches every tenant in one round trip; TryGet walks four buckets in precedence order: tenant×AppName, tenant×IncludeScope, global×AppName, global×IncludeScope. Tenant axis dominates the scope axis. Within a single bag (tenant or global), AppName beats IncludeScopes. Added matrix tests covering the 4-bucket cube with multiple scopes × multiple tenants × multiple keys.

Unit-test hardening for the composed resolution walk. Added matrix-test design pattern (Theory + MemberData generating the (resolver-returns × bucket-seeded) cube) to ensure every combination of present/absent at each precedence level resolves deterministically. No production code change.

implement.behavioral_diff: v0.9.0 introduces per-request multi-tenancy across all layers. The final design (after B62 refactor) uses a single consumer-implemented ITenantResolver interface. The host registers a resolver via b.AddTenantResolver<TResolver>() inside AddDbConfig; the resolver is called on every IConfiguration[key] read; IOptionsSnapshot<T> automatically becomes tenant-aware because it rebinds from IConfiguration per request scope. No custom options API is needed. The DB schema gained a TenantId column on both tables. The HTTP API accepts ?tenantId= on all endpoints. The UI surfaces a Tenant field in the scope selector, a Tenant column in the entries table, and pre-filled TenantId in the create dialog. IOptions<T> is singleton-cached and always gets global config — consumers MUST use IOptionsSnapshot<T> for tenant-aware types. Memory ceiling is documented at ~10K tenants x 100 keys (~200 MB); lazy per-tenant loading is deferred to v0.10.0+.
